# MongoDB test binary downloads

| Field  | Value                  |
| ------ | ---------------------- |
| Issue  | re-cinq/HALEngine#144   |
| Status | Shipped                |

The MongoDB integration suites start real database processes, with binary downloads coordinated by filesystem locks.

## Download isolation

- Test processes sharing a cache root use separate download directories keyed by process id, preventing concurrent workers from sharing a binary download lock ([validated by: isolates download locks for processes sharing a cache](../../src/infrastructure/stores/mongo/mongoDownload.test.ts#L6)).

## Tradeoff

Each worker downloads its own binary on its first MongoDB suite; subsequent suites in that process reuse it from the temporary directory.
EOF
